text:
Type: striped rectangular lumbar cushion
Use: back support and a color accent on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: bohemian, traditional, retro
Materials: woven cotton fabric with yarn-dyed stripes
Colors: deep red, navy blue, mustard yellow, sage green, white, black
Shape: long rectangle with bold vertical stripes built from finer pinstripes, flat seamed edges, softly filled, compact
Feel: cheerful, lively, homely, warm
Goes with: neutral or navy sofas, warm wood, rattan, cream walls; bohemian, farmhouse or eclectic rooms
